title: 14 NEW MSFS Marketplace Releases: A320 Airline Bundles, Summer Schedules & 72 Landing Challenges!
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just dropped a massive wave of 14 new activity packs and operational add-ons for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. Whether you want to command scheduled Airbus A320 operations across diverse commercial networks, test your crosswind technique in 72 rigorous landing challenges, inject authentic international summer timetables into major global hubs, or throttle back for low-and-slow river discovery flights across the globe, this drop brings serious replay value to your simulator. We divide the breakdown into four distinct categories:

✈️ Curated Commercial Bundles & Special Operations: We explore high-value multi-packs and commemorative drops, starting with Perfect Flight’s 12 Legs Spring 2026 Master Collection #2 for the iniBuilds A320 V2—bundling Ryanair, Southwest, and QantasLink packages with custom liveries, 12 IFR legs, and over 100 monitored flight events. We also cover the Advanced Landings Master Collection #6 featuring 72 unique landing tests across Australia, Canada, and remote islands, alongside the America 250 JetBlue "Vets in Blue" special edition with 12 dedicated IFR missions.

📅 Global Airline Fleet Schedules (Summer Overhaul by VA Systems): A comprehensive look at summer schedule timetable expansions across five major global carriers: Jet2, Hawaiian Airlines, Air Serbia, Norwegian Air Shuttle, and Singapore Airlines. We review the authentic real-world route networks and liveries, alongside important buyer reminders regarding base aircraft dependencies (such as the A380).

🌍 International Hub Traffic Overhauls (by VA Systems): Timetable and livery injections designed to populate airport gates with realistic airline operations. This week's featured airports include Nairobi (HKJK), Orlando (KMCO), Zurich (LSZH), Lima (SPJC), and Jakarta (WIII).

🗺️ Scenic Bush & Waterway Expeditions: Throttle back for low-altitude scenic touring. We follow Koschi’s discounted World Rivers IX through XII bundle, tracing famous waterways with full narrated audio tours along the Nile, Yangtze, Danube, and Volga rivers.

Whether you're executing complex commercial rotations in the A320 or flying low and slow along the world's most famous waterways, this marketplace release has plenty of flying to keep your logbook full.

Drop a comment below and let me know: Which of these routes or schedules are you flying first? Make sure to hit the like button, subscribe to High in the Flightsim Sky for weekly flight simulator updates, and clear skies on your next flight!
